home.headline: Homes that are still open
home.lede: Every listing here shows the last time a person confirmed it was actually available. Nothing sits on this site quietly rotting.
home.confirmedThisWeek: {count, plural, =0 {No listings confirmed this week} =1 {1 listing confirmed available this week} other {# listings confirmed available this week}}
home.areasLede: The neighbourhoods Addis renters open first.
home.recentTitle: Confirmed in the last three days
home.explainerLede: Every listing has a thirty-day life. The lister resets it by confirming the place is still free. Run the clock out and the listing leaves search.
home.explainerFresh: Confirmed in the last week. Call with confidence.
home.explainerAgeing: Confirmed one to three weeks ago. Probably fine, worth asking.
home.explainerStale: Nothing for three weeks or more. Treat it as gone.
home.explainerExpired: Thirty days with no word. Removed from search until the lister comes back.
home.problemBody: Ask anyone who has looked for a place in Addis and you get the same story: you call about a house and it went three months ago. Sites here have no reason to remove a dead listing, so they do not. Bete makes the age of the information the most visible thing on the card.

detail.notFoundBody: It may have expired, or the reference may be wrong. Expired listings leave search after thirty days without confirmation.

results.emptyExpiredNote: Listings that go thirty days without confirmation leave search, so this page shows fewer homes than a site that never removes anything. That is deliberate.

post.title: Post a listing
post.lede: Seven steps. Draft saves on this device as you go. Submissions wait in moderation before they appear in search.
post.pinHint: Tap the map or drag the pin. The public pin is approximate until you speak to the seeker.
post.photosHint: Upload photos (compressed in the browser) or paste image URLs. First photo is the cover — reorder with the arrows.
post.reviewNote: This goes to the moderation queue as PENDING. It will not appear in search until approved.
post.submitFailed: Could not submit. Check the form and try again.
post.invalidDraft: Some required fields are missing or invalid.
post.unknownArea: That area is not on the list.
post.rentPeriodRequired: Say whether rent is monthly or yearly.
post.invalidPhotoUrl: That photo URL is not valid.
